blocks.html: Short answer: For ancient capitals choose Ayutthaya and Sukhothai; for a northern wooden-house, horse-carriage town, Lampang; for Sino-Portuguese quarters, Phuket Old Town or Songkhla; and for an old riverside community, Chanthaburi.

items.name: Ayutthaya
items.blurb: A former capital and World Heritage city, with ruins, temples and stupas across the island — cycle or take a boat around to soak up the history in a day.

items.name: Sukhothai
items.blurb: Thailand’s first capital, with a spacious, beautifully landscaped historical park, Wat Mahathat and graceful Sukhothai-era Buddha images — lovely to explore quietly by bike.

items.name: Lampang
items.blurb: A slow-paced northern town known for its horse carriages, the Kad Kong Ta old street of wooden riverside houses and beautiful wooden temples — great for old-town lovers who like an unhurried pace.

items.name: Phuket Old Town
items.blurb: A colorful Sino-Portuguese old quarter with cafés, Peranakan restaurants and street art — a delight to walk and photograph, a different side of beach-famous Phuket.

items.name: Songkhla
items.blurb: Songkhla’s old town around Nang Ngam and Nakhon Nok streets has Sino-Portuguese buildings, cafés, street art and local food, near Samila Beach and the Hub Ho Hin mill — great southern old-town wandering.

items.name: Chanthaburi
items.blurb: The Chanthaboon riverside community of old wooden houses and Thailand’s largest Catholic cathedral, with a historic gem-trading quarter and local food — a quiet east-coast old town.

faq.q: Ayutthaya or Sukhothai for old towns?
faq.a: Ayutthaya is near Bangkok with large ruins and is good as a day trip, while Sukhothai is farther but tidier and calmer and easy to cycle; with time, visiting both shows the development of Thai art from Sukhothai to Ayutthaya.

Phuket Old Town and Songkhla are the two prettiest, liveliest Sino-Portuguese quarters, with colorful buildings, cafés, street art and Peranakan food that are a joy to walk and photograph, and both are near the coast to combine with a beach.

faq.q: Can I combine old towns with other sights?
faq.a: Yes — Phuket Old Town pairs with the beaches and island tours, Songkhla with Samila Beach and Hat Yai, Chanthaburi with Phlio waterfall and the Trat coast, and Lampang sits on the Chiang Mai–Bangkok route for an easy old-town stop.
